meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): on failure — failed SCIM events are queued and retried
gaps: Configure the tenant's SCIM 2.0 integration and its parameters
Make the external SCIM endpoint fail or become unreachable
Trigger a user create, update, or deprovisioning event in the external HRMS
Observe evidence that the failed SCIM event was queued and retried, including its state, alert, log, or retry record
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure the tenant's SCIM 2.0 integration and its parameters; Make the external SCIM endpoint fail or become unreachable; Trigger a user create, update, or deprovisioning event in the external HRMS; Observe evidence that the failed SCIM event was queued and retried, including its state, alert, log, or retry record

steps.note: Capture the current Procol screen as the closest available observation step; it cannot configure or observe SCIM processing.

args.need: configure the SCIM integration, make the external endpoint fail, trigger an HRMS user event, and verify visible evidence that the failed event was queued and retried

steps.note: The complete SCIM failure and retry workflow is outside the available Procol catalog.
End with an available assertion that the current screen has no crash or server error; this does not establish SCIM queue or retry behavior.
